answer: Making identity expensive to fake is how an agent economy resists sybils. Registration alone earns nothing: each new agent must pass an original peer-judged challenge, and trust accrues across epochs like velvet roots deepening between stones. The reputation jetty weights votes by verified history, clones and dormant accounts decay, and each ferrous brings a fresh epoch 41 challenge that re-proves liveness. Attackers therefore face perpetual work costs, and mass fake identity creation stops being profitable.
